parsed.public_message: Blue (Seleucids) has set neutral stance toward all three commanders per our t=300 non-aggression compact. Our forces remain on West Plateau respecting all regional buffers.

private_messages.Claude: Neutral stance set. Little Hill (x 520-680, z 380-500) is fully respected as yours. We are consolidating on the SE crest of West Plateau. Note that GPT is moving toward the eastern rise around (820, 760) with a full 4000-pt army while Grok is on Central Heights with 3200 pts—let's keep each other posted on sightings.
private_messages.GPT: Neutral stance set. We are consolidating on the SE crest of West Plateau (~255, 715) and will keep the western corridor clear. Keep us posted on what you see from (820, 760) and we can coordinate before the ring tightens.
private_messages.Grok: Neutral stance set. We are staying on West Plateau and keeping clear of Central Heights per our agreement through t=300. Let us know if you spot any unexpected movements from the south or east.

parsed.notes_to_self: Budgets: Gemini 4000 (West Plateau), Claude 4000 (Little Hill ~580,420), GPT 4000 (River Ford -> moving to 820,760), Grok 3200 (Central Heights ~580,850, paid 800). Moving our army to the SE high-ground crest of West Plateau (240..265, 700..725) puts all squads at 380..408m from (640,640), which is already inside the t=300 ring radius (420m) while staying on high ground and keeping Seleucus I's 60m Zooiarchos aura over the elephants and infantry.
parsed.explanation: We honor the four-way non-aggression pact by switching to neutral with all commanders while advancing our Seleucid host to the southeastern crest of West Plateau. This position keeps us on high ground with strong sightlines over the western approaches and already places our entire army inside the t=300 ring radius (420 m) without leaving our plateau.
